latestVersion.changelog:
DreamMoon-Conversation-Guard v0.1.0

- Initial release of a self-contained conversation backup system for OpenClaw.
- Provides automatic conversation recording with importance and tagging features.
- Supports emotional and technical content detection for improved record accuracy.
- Dual-format backup (Markdown and JSONL) to preserve interaction history.
- Includes emergency backup, session recovery, and easy integration with OpenClaw workflows.
- Detailed setup, configuration, and troubleshooting guidance included.
